items.q: And I guess she put me under her wing, you know, big hearted.

ctx.x: And he thought I -- she thought I was in for a good time. So, she took me upstairs to her appartment, and, so, I opened my heart to her. I said, "I'm sorry, but I have no money. I have no job. If you could let me sleep here, I can, I can clean the house for you or wash windows or wash dishes or wash everything. I want earn my keep." And I guess she put me under her wing, you know, big hearted. Those type of ladies are very good hearted. So, she said, "I'm gonna ask my husband. Let's go back downstairs." And so,…
